dataset: curated labels against bundled markdown fixture corpus
limitations: Mock embeddings have no semantic signal; the dense result is diagnostic only.
The 30 queries and target clause labels are curated, not independently annotated or blind-held-out.
The corpus contains a hash-pinned maintainer transcription of the PUCSL GP-2 tariff schedule plus unverified comfort fixtures; the pin is not a publisher digital signature.
The benchmark measures clause ranking only, not answer faithfulness or whether a source is official.
